description: Harness-neutral discovery catalog for Multimodal Embedding Serving workflow skills. Paths are relative to the microservice root.

skills.name: multimodal-embedding-serving-user
skills.description: Deploy and consume the multimodal embedding service: bring it up from a repo clone (setup.sh + compose) or standalone (prebuilt intel/multimodal-embedding-serving image), embed text/images/videos over REST on port 9777, pick the right model, or integrate in-process via the Python SDK wheel. Not for modifying the service's source (use multimodal-embedding-serving-dev).

skills.name: multimodal-embedding-serving-dev
skills.description: Develop the multimodal embedding service itself: Poetry install, run the existing tests, navigate the wrapper/registry/handler architecture, add a new model family, and build the image from source. Not for merely deploying or calling the API (use multimodal-embedding-serving-user).
